notes.title: Overhaul Original Soundtrack is available everywhere!
notes.content:
Hey friends!

The original soundtrack of our freshly baked game is finally available on Steam, YouTube, and every major streaming platform.
You can find all the links on our website: https://www.breadpandagames.com/

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2143860/Overhaul_Original_Soundtrack/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40609337/4be0c8547820bfc343150e80412f5ad2ee3cb572.png[/img][/url]

You now also have the possibility to buy a bundle (game + OST) with a -15% discount!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/28507/Overhaul__Original_Soundtrack/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40609337/00d64a2ee19ba1edb163abaef5d0ee8acb4b2042.png[/img][/url]

We hope you'll have a blast listening to this album. It was a long creative process and we are proud to let the music have such a big impact on our game identity. 

Thank you for playing. We'll see you soon, take care! ♥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40609337/62c61c1f005855531e330e1597ad410a26b245f8.png[/img]

notes.title: Overhaul is now available!
notes.content:
We can officially announce that [b]Overhaul is finally available[/b] on Steam, with a special -20% discount until October, 21st! 

We hope you'll enjoy the game as much as we loved crafting it. We're looking forward to reading your thoughts through the reviews and comments. Feel free to contact us via email or on our social networks, @BreadPandaGames.

Thank you all! ♥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40609337/a59a100485478b08b4fe46e5ed593e95de48ccca.png[/img]

notes.title: Overhaul release date and new demo!
notes.content:
Hey folks! 

[b]Big news![/b]

[h2][b]Overhaul [/b]will finally be released on [b]October, 14th! [/b][/h2]

And to make this release date official, we've released a [b]launch trailer[/b]! Enjoy! 

Also, and for the second time, we participate in the [b]Steam Fest[/b], with [b]a fresh and bigger-than-ever game demo[/b], so you have something to nibble on waiting for the main dish! 


We hope you'll enjoy the demo. Wishlisting Overhaul is still the best way to support the game before the release. 
We've opened a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1608660/discussions/0/3362524231624065415/]discussion post[/url] for you to leave your feedback after experiencing the demo, you can also contact us on our social media, @BreadPandaGames.

Thanks for sticking with us!


[previewyoutube=Zxl_BbXYSM8;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: We're going to Stunfest!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40609337/2133d775383aa570e66cbbc6ec2089b73a5d6bfd.png[/img]

Hey!

On May 21st we'll have the pleasure to exhibit Overhaul at Stunfest! It's one of France's biggest gaming events, mostly fighting games related but they've been hosting an indie alley for a couple years. 

It's our very first physical event, we can expect a few thousand people to walk down the aisle of the festival on Saturday alone. We'll also have the opportunity to meet fellow game devs and publishers.

We'll also post a bunch of pictures of the event on our [url=https://twitter.com/BreadPandaGames]socials [/url]!

Have a good one! 👋

notes.title: New Key Art!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40609337/f1593bd3a1a8799bd13d624264e4f774659c9794.png[/img]

Hey! 

We've just revamped the Steam page with a new artwork. As the game's been evolving since last year's artwork, we decided to drop a new one.

We went for a more classic composition compared to the previous one. The most important part was figuring out the colors. As our main character Ikalee is mainly orangey with warm colors, we started with blue and green. It was a balancing act of adding bright colors in the background without distracting from the main character.

We decided to show a few other elements from the game, like the door on the left and a seed in Ikalee's hand. The room itself is also one you'll be able to find in the game.

Hope you guys enjoy it!

notes.title: Fresh new demo for "Going Rogue: A Festival of Persistance"!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40609337/5c440f9b8cff0ec87f760f4a2dc1e4873875f796.png[/img]

Hello guys, we've baked a pretty cool [b]new demo[/b] with fun stuff for you to try out, like a [b]brand new tutorial[/b] and ... [b]Ikalee speaking throughout the game and reacting to what's around[/b]! 

You'll also be welcomed by [b]a fully hand-drawn cutscene introduction[/b], that will set the mood and explain the story of [b]Ikalee [/b]and his tribe, the [b]Sol'Kins[/b].

Hope you'll like it and feel free to reply to this post with your feedback and thoughts!
Happy gaming! ♥

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Demo!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40609337/1fc49822906f8c347bec48625af684103da71f5d.png[/img]

[h2]From October 1st to 7th[/h2]

You'll be able to venture into the [b]Power Plant[/b] to get a first taste of the gameplay of [b]Overhaul[/b]!

In this demo we've gathered over [b]40 rooms[/b], [b]5 items[/b] as well as [b]several mechanics and unlocks[/b] to give you a good idea of what's in store when you get the complete game!

We've created a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1608660/discussions/0/2954914688118067610/]discussion post[/url] where you can leave your feedback after experiencing the demo, you can also contact us on our social medias.
